proposed_errata.reason: I retain uncertain after considering the original direct-contusion positive and its microtrabecular-versus-discrete-line distinction. The source affirmatively names microtrabecular fracturing at the sole contusion site without clarifying whether a discrete line exists. I cannot infer a line-free injury from silence or apply an unverified automatic subtype exception. This is not a positive fracture diagnosis and does not deny impact-related edema. Preserve the original interpretation and keep the proposed positive-to-uncertain change pending distinct source review.

The report expressly excepts the tibial subcortical cyst from the remaining normal bone morphology and signal; it does not explicitly assess local edema or contusion at that lesion.
